messages.subject: javascript error when using matrixInput
parts:
Hello! 

I am using matrixInput function from the package shiny-incubator (https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-incubator/blob/master/R/tableinput.R) and it was working well. But even though I did not change anything recently, now the application stops as soon as this function is called. The following message appears: "The application unexpectedly exited. Diagnostic information has been dumped to the JavaScript error console."

I would greatly appreciate if you gave me a hint how to proceed with solving this issue. Thank you in advance!

messages.author: 3db6afff8c7482ad
messages.subject: Re: javascript error when using matrixInput
parts: Ok, I found a solution. Had to correct the line 322 in tableinput.js See https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-incubator/commit/f849e2d31c50cca27c90c74c4633639b154bf12a
